pool.text: Primary oscillator [APBC-0] operates under the relation the differentiable function \( f(x) = 2x^2 + 4x \). What is the instantaneous derivative \( f'(3) \)?
pool.sol: By the power rule, \( f'(x) = 4x + 4 \). Substituting \( x = 3 \) gives \( f'(3) = 4(3) + 4 = 16 \).

fig.title: Curve f(x) = 2x² + 4x and Tangent at x = 3

pool.text: A particle moves along parametric path \( x(t) = 3t^2 \), \( y(t) = 5t \). What is the velocity vector \( \mathbf{v}(t) = \langle x'(t), y'(t) \rangle \)?
pool.sol: Differentiating component-wise gives \( x'(t) = 6t \) and \( y'(t) = 5 \).

pool.text: What is the Maclaurin series expansion for \( f(x) = e^{4x} \)?
pool.sol: Substitute \( u = 4x \) into \( e^u = \sum_{n=0}^\infty \frac{u^n}{n!} \) to obtain \( \sum_{n=0}^\infty \frac{(4x)^n}{n!} \).

pool.domain: Unit 10 · Power Series, Taylor & Maclaurin Series
pool.text: Integrating \( \dfrac{1}{1+x^{2}}=\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{\infty}(-1)^kx^{2k} \) term-by-term gives the Maclaurin series for \(\arctan x\). Find the coefficient of \(x^{21}\).
pool.sol: \(\displaystyle\int\sum(-1)^kx^{2k}dx=\sum\dfrac{(-1)^kx^{2k+1}}{2k+1}\). At \(2k+1=21\): coefficient \(=\dfrac{(-1)^{10}}{21}=\frac{1}{21}.\)

pool.text: Differentiating the Maclaurin series \( \dfrac{1}{1-x}=\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{\infty}x^{k} \) term-by-term gives the series for \( \dfrac{1}{(1-x)^{2}} \). Find the coefficient of \(x^{4}\).
pool.sol: \(\dfrac{d}{dx}\displaystyle\sum x^k=\sum kx^{k-1}=\dfrac{1}{(1-x)^2}=\sum_{n=0}^\infty(n+1)x^n\). Coefficient of \(x^{4}\) is \(4+1=5.\)
